name: @240xu/dsh-session-search
description: DSH web plugin: cross-session full-text search over all persisted session logs (user/assistant/system messages). Incremental mtime+size index cached at $DSH_HOME/cache/session-search (zero writes to ~/.dsh/sessions), standalone HTML panel page, fenced HTTP API and a tolerant session_search agent tool. 跨会话全文搜索：增量索引、独立面板页、HTTP API 与 session_search 代理工具。零 npm 依赖。
author: 240xu
